title: Phase 4: limits, redaction, and no-egress enforcement
objective: Harden the operational envelope: enforced default limits, log truncation, Authorization redaction, loopback default bind, and an offline runtime that cannot execute fixture code.
specReferences: §19.3 no arbitrary code execution in fixtures
nextAction: run fresh specifier, then coder, cleaner, hardener, and QA stages
notes: scope amendment 2026-09-30 (PM): added internal/cli/serve.go because the operational logger currently lives inside serve.go and C-CLI-010 needs it extracted/truncated; internal/host/http/server.go for the §19.4/§20 log body-preview truncation and limit wiring; and .agent/guards.json because C-ARCH-004 (no network egress) and C-ARCH-005 (fixtures are data, no code execution) are best enforced structurally by the existing arch guard, which already supports arbitrary per-package forbidExact/forbidPrefix rules, so no cmd/guard source change is needed.
